Tudor Ranger M79950-0003 vs Grand Seiko SBGW231: same money, USD 3,675 vs 3,900.

Both prices are retailer listings checked on 22 Nov 2026. The gap is about 6%.

The Tudor is a steel field watch with a black dial and fabric strap. The Grand Seiko is a steel dress watch with a cream dial and leather strap.

Which one would you buy at this price? Comment A or B.

Prices can change. This is not advice to buy.

Source: Watches of Switzerland and Exquisite Timepieces, prices checked 22 Nov 2026.
